equipmentAgeAssumption: Use yearBuilt unless inspection notes give equipment age
source: avgElecKWhPer1800sqft: EIA RECS 2020 CE1.1 and CE2.1 (see avgElecNote). Efficiency, kWhPerUnit and baseTonsPer1000sqft are still PLACEHOLDER (AHRI/DOE minimum efficiency history; Manual J sizing).
avgElecNote: avgElecKWhPer1800sqft: RECS 2020 CE2.1 average electricity per household (million Btu x 293.071 kWh/MMBtu) divided by average home size (CE1.1: per-household MMBtu / per-sq-ft kBtu), times 1,800 sq ft. RECS climate regions: 5A = Very cold/Cold, 4A = Mixed-humid, 2B = Mixed-dry/Hot-dry.
